notes: Registry of the natural persons authorised to record compliance sign-offs / reviews for how2vote. This is the single source of truth for WHO may sign off; it is deliberately separate from operator.json, which is the operating ENTITY (National Digital), not individuals. Reviewer/approver references elsewhere resolve to a signatory `id` here: data/source/*/{aec-sources,ballot-verification,candidate-mapping}.json and the internal-reviewer entries of docs/legal/control-register.json. scripts/check-signatories.mjs validates this file and fails the build on any id-shaped reviewer reference that does not resolve to an active signatory whose scope covers the sign-off. External/pending reviewers that are not natural persons in this registry (e.g. an external legal practitioner engaged periodically) are recorded as descriptive strings, not ids, and are exempt from resolution. Signatories with publicProfile:true are additionally surfaced as schema.org Person structured data on the public site (see apps/web/src/lib/structured-data.ts); the sameAs array is the authoritative external-identity set for that markup.

scopes.all: Authorised to record any compliance sign-off across every control domain.
